```yaml
name: Release precompiled binaries

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - '[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  create-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate tag against Cargo.toml
        run: |
          TAG=${GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}
          VERSION=$(grep '^version' Cargo.toml | head -1 | awk -F\" '{print $2}')
          if [ "$TAG" != "$VERSION" ]; then
            echo "Tag $TAG does not match Cargo.toml version $VERSION"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Create draft release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          draft: true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  build-cli:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: linux-x86_64-cpu
            os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            features: ''
            cuda: ''
            cross: false
          - name: linux-x86_64-cuda-11.8
            os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            features: '--features cuda11_8'
            cuda: '11.8'
            cross: false
          - name: linux-x86_64-cuda-12.4
            os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_0-unknown-linux-gnu
            features: '--features cuda12_4'
            cuda: '12.4'
            cross: false
          - name: linux-x86_64-cuda-13.0
            os: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            features: '--features cuda13_0'
            cuda: '13.0'
            cross: false
          - name: linux-aarch64
            os: ubuntu-latest
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            features: ''
            cuda: ''
            cross: true
          - name: macos-arm64
            os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            features: '--features metal'
            cuda: ''
            cross: false
    env:
      RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          override: true

      - name: Install cross
        if: ${{ matrix.cross }}
        run: cargo install cross --version 0.2.5

      - name: Install CUDA Toolkit
        if: ${{ matrix.cuda != '' }}
        uses: Jimver/cuda-toolkit@v0.2.0
        with:
          cuda: ${{ matrix.cuda }}
          network: true

      - name: Install lld
        run: |
          if [ "${{ runner.os }}" = "Linux" ]; then
            sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y lld
          else
            brew install lld
          fi

      - name: Build
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.cross }}" = "true" ]; then
            cross build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ matrix.features }}
          else
            cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} ${{ matrix.features }}
          fi

      - name: Package binary
        run: |
          BIN_PATH=target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/cake
          tar -czf cake-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz -C $(dirname $BIN_PATH) $(basename $BIN_PATH)

      - name: Compute checksum
        run: |
          shasum -a 256 cake-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz > cake-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz.sha256

      - name: Upload assets
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          draft: true
          files: |
            cake-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz
            cake-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz.sha256
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  build-mobile:
    needs: create-release
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: android-aarch64
            os: ubuntu-latest
            target: aarch64-linux-android
            libname: libcake_mobile.so
            cross: true
          - name: ios-arm64
            os: macos-latest
            target: aarch64-apple-ios
            libname: libcake_mobile.a
            cross: false
    env:
      RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          override: true

      - name: Install cross
        if: ${{ matrix.cross }}
        run: cargo install cross --version 0.2.5

      - name: Install lld
        run: |
          if [ "${{ runner.os }}" = "Linux" ]; then
            sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y lld
          else
            brew install lld
          fi

      - name: Build
        run: |
          if [ "${{ matrix.cross }}" = "true" ]; then
            cross build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} --lib
          else
            cargo build --release --target ${{ matrix.target }} --lib
          fi

      - name: Package library
        run: |
          LIB_PATH=target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/${{ matrix.libname }}
          tar -czf libcake_mobile-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz -C $(dirname $LIB_PATH) $(basename $LIB_PATH)

      - name: Compute checksum
        run: |
          shasum -a 256 libcake_mobile-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz > libcake_mobile-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz.sha256

      - name: Upload assets
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          draft: true
          files: |
            libcake_mobile-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz
            libcake_mobile-${{ matrix.name }}.tar.gz.sha256
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  publish-release:
    needs: [build-cli, build-mobile]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Publish release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v1
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          draft: false
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
